scope: Full visual article, seven diagrams, 62 concept descriptions, map view introductions, connection explanations and export walkthrough. Companion library entry copy clarified; canonical catalog and expanded essays remain separate reference material.

changes.difficulty: The Lab and the term agent were assumed known.
changes.revision: Introduced the framework, AI agent, records and contracts before the governance model.

changes.difficulty: Admission sounded like deployment or evidence of truth.
changes.revision: Explained formal acceptance and separated it from deployment, activation and claim support.

changes.difficulty: Artifact types, schemas, instances and relation endpoints were named before explanation.
changes.revision: Explained required formats and particular records; used the experiment, capability and product to explain source and target direction.

changes.difficulty: Provenance and evidence were presented as abstract bindings.
changes.revision: Named input data, code version, counting method, output and the conditions supporting a claim; explained a digest as a content fingerprint.

changes.difficulty: Lifecycle and change terminology assumed familiarity with semantic versions.
changes.revision: Added examples distinguishing changed meaning, changed encoding and rebuilt views in an optional disclosure.

changes.difficulty: Product, project, intent and realization binding lacked a practical route.
changes.revision: Followed a customer need through platform, repair project, export capability, selected software and work item.

changes.difficulty: Ontology projection, cuts and graph paths assumed graph-model knowledge.
changes.revision: Explained concepts, nodes, edges and selected consistent recorded state; distinguished graph representation from source records and permission.

changes.difficulty: Principal, delegation and authority envelope were hard to distinguish.
changes.revision: Explained recognized identity, explicit permissions and limits separately from profile, assignment and technical ability.

changes.difficulty: Durable, ephemeral and currentness obscured agent behavior across time.
changes.revision: Used saved project state, temporary working memory and explicit conditions for refreshing task information.

changes.difficulty: Pagination and falsifiers assumed specialist knowledge.
changes.revision: Explained batch retrieval near the start; named the result that would contradict the lesson prediction.

changes.difficulty: Failure classification, incident and control binding assumed their purposes.
changes.revision: Added failure-pattern, specific-occurrence, assessment and response examples without equating classification with cause.

changes.difficulty: Operational descriptions could be read as an installed complete platform.
changes.revision: Kept the 8 October source snapshot, accepted local software, proposed update, limited ontology evidence and unfinished release distinct.

local_links: all paths and local fragment targets resolve
declared_relation_examples: declared ordered signatures match captured catalog
verification_scope: Editorial review and static document construction. No browser run, implementation tests or participant usability evaluation.
